reviews.text:
I'm so grateful to Arnau for his dedicated care of each dog, and I felt incredibly fortunate to witness his daily interactions with them. The dogs were all so relaxed and comfortable around him, radiating energy and smiles; you could feel their trust in him.

Arnau meticulously cares for each dog based on their personality, physical condition, and the owner's needs, taking them to run freely in forests and meadows. During their stays, he provides ample companionship and a sense of security. I wholeheartedly recommend Arnau to every pet owner. You can completely trust him with your dog, and your furry friend will enjoy a loving and joyful time. 🐾❤️

We left our Maltese with them and we're delighted. They treat them wonderfully, offer lots of activities in nature and the forest, and are incredibly attentive. They also send you lots of photos and videos of what they're doing. We'll definitely be back! Thank you!

Arnau is the best. Always on time, always reliable. Constantly provides updates, and meticulous at what he does. He’s obviously great with dogs, and ours is obsessed with him like all others. We can’t say Arnau’s name out loud at home, otherwise our dog might spend an hour looking at the door expecting Arnau to come pick him up. Thanks so much for caring for our boi so well 🙏

Our dog Q goes for a walk every week with Arnau and stays with him when we go on vacation, and he couldn't love it more! He always comes back super happy and tired from running around the mountains with him and the other dogs. We don't know what we would do without Arnau. 100% recommended!

1000% recommended. Arnau and his team are excellent professionals, responsible, and very kind to dogs. I've left my Labrador with them several times while traveling, and I always have peace of mind knowing she's in good hands and having a great time. They're my first choice. They send photos and videos, and I know she's made lots of friends, and I love seeing her happy. I especially appreciate that they take the dogs to the mountains and take great care of them there, in addition to treating them like family at home. Thank you!

Very good. Lulo always comes back very happy (and tired) from the walks with passeigs x barcelona. And when he has stayed in residence everything has gone very well. They send us photos and make everything very easy. Highly recommended!
Would highly recommend/10. Arnau is so kind and trustworthy. Or if you’re reading this review to your dog: wOOf wOOOf!!

Arnau is a very trustworthy and thoughtful individual, whom I would recommend to anyone needing dog care services. He is a true dog whisperer, gentle and kind. He goes above and beyond, engaging all of his clients' furry family members 😊 I would 10/10 recommend to anyone who would like their dogs to unleash their energy in the outdoor fresh air.
I'm very happy with Arnau and company's service; our little Max always comes back happy and relaxed. I highly recommend them!

I'm very happy with the mountain walking service for my dog. Arnau and the team are very responsible and caring towards Tommy. He's always punctual and sends me photos and videos during the walks, which I love. Thanks to this service, my dog ​​is much more active and happy. I definitely recommend it to other dog owners who want their pets to enjoy nature.

Excellent!! Their professionalism with pets is evident; they're always very attentive. They sent me photos and videos whenever they could, which made me feel much safer leaving my dog ​​with them. I've relied on them ever since I arrived in Barcelona. 10/10!!

I've been using Arnau's independent dog sitting services for a while now, and he's fantastic. He really gives each dog personalized attention, sends updates and photos throughout the day, and my pup always comes back happy and relaxed. You can tell he truly loves animals and goes above and beyond. Highly recommend!

Arnau is very professional. I was a little worried about leaving my dog ​​while I went on vacation because she had only ever stayed with family and friends before. But everything went perfectly, and I will definitely leave my dog ​​with him again next time I travel.

I'm so lucky to have found him!
